description: Move a window to another tmux session, after its last window or just before or after one of its windows (`before` / `after`, which need tmux 3.2 or later and also reorder a window inside its own session). The window keeps its id, panes and programs, and the destination session's current window stays as it was. When it was the last window of its session, tmux closes that session.

anyOf.description: Window id like `@3`, or an index as text.

WindowArg.description: A window as callers name it: an id (`"@3"`) or an index (`2` or `"2"`).

after.description: Put it just after this window of `target_session` (id or index). Needs tmux 3.2 or later. Without `before` or `after` it goes after the session's last window.

before.description: Put it just before this window of `target_session` (id or index). Needs tmux 3.2 or later.

session.description: Session id (`$5`) or exact name of the session the window is in.

target_session.description: Session id (`$5`) or exact name of the session to move it to. Its own session reorders it, with `before` or `after`.

session_id.description: Id of the session the window is in now.

source_session_closed.description: It was the last window of its session, so tmux closed that session.

window_id.description: Window id, the same as before the move.

window_index.description: Its index in that session now.
